scope: All five datasets and three original splits; within-context unseen single perturbation
baseline: Original frozen UC; raw uniform KRR is a distinct full-response control
alignment: Train-only positive off-diagonal centred kernel alignment to unit-residual response geometry excluding all panel target genes; weights=0.5*uniform+0.5*normalized_positive_alignment; no held labels
direction: Train centred response rows normalized to median training residual norm, then centred again; no predicted-direction renormalization; gains1/2
neighbors: Top3/10/30 cosine prior neighbors; softmax temperature0.1; transfer measured training residuals
validation_objective: Maximize average L2/Cosine PDS; ties by structural Spearman, specific Pearson, smaller expression RMSE, candidate ID
safe_constraints: Expression RMSE <=1.01 baseline; both PDS, specific Pearson, DEG AP and structural Spearman >=baseline; matrix RMSE <=baseline. Undefined necessary baseline metric retains baseline; undefined candidate fails.
safe_stability: Among constrained nonbaseline candidates select maximal 10th percentile of 2000 target-cluster bootstrap paired mean PDS gains; require >0. This is a selection heuristic, not multiplicity-adjusted significance.
diagnostic_arms: Also freeze best candidate of EACH of five families by validation objective, irrespective of safe gates; evaluate all and report tradeoffs. Diagnostic arms are not approved replacements.
freeze: All selections and refit predictions sealed before loading any test truth
prior_task_constraints: Same masks, control references, gene axes, data splits and comparator predictions. Shared-centred Pearson uses equal-target fit-only reference; DEG AP, not nonlinear AUPRC.
